description:
One command method family and its CLI and HTTP adapters converge after the external Git primitives land.

## Background

`DocumentOps` currently has parallel content, history and diff methods; the Git owner supplies version selection and Git primitives.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: CLI and HTTP consume one core content, history and diff method family, removing obsolete parallel methods.
- [hard] REQ-02: Preserve binary bytes, linked-document validation, working-tree edits for unpinned documents and supported HTTP diff; tests compare selected-version bytes and exercise diff.

## Notes

See `dev/active/0f8efc37-frontends-share-core/plan.md` and its linked investigation for scope and existing consumers.
title: Converge document operation adapters
